title: Healthcheck Report
description: Schema for the Healthcheck_Report.md structured data. Produced by healthcheck-validation-skill during Gate 7 post-deploy monitoring. Contains time-series results for the mandatory 5-minute monitoring window.

monitored_endpoint.description: The healthcheck endpoint URL being monitored.

monitoring_started_at.description: Timestamp when monitoring began (immediately after deploy completed).

monitoring_interval_seconds.description: Interval between healthcheck calls in seconds.

results.description: Time-series healthcheck results. One entry per check (every 30s for 5min = 10 entries).

db_check.description: Database connectivity check result from healthcheck response.

response_body_valid.description: True if response body matches expected schema {status, timestamp, version}.

response_status_value.description: The 'status' field value from the healthcheck response body.

notes.description: Optional notes (e.g., 'cold start delay', 'timeout - retried', 'rollback triggered after this check').

summary.description: Aggregate statistics for the monitoring window.

total_checks.description: Total number of healthcheck calls made.

checks_passed.description: Number of checks that returned HTTP 200 with valid body.

checks_failed.description: Number of checks that returned non-200 or invalid body.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Maximum consecutive failures in the monitoring window. >= 3 triggers rollback.

avg_response_time_ms.description: Average response time across all checks.

rollback_triggered.description: True if 3 consecutive failures triggered the rollback procedure.

rollback_trigger_check_number.description: The check number at which the 3rd consecutive failure occurred (and rollback was triggered).

overall_status.description: PASS: all checks passed. FAIL_ROLLBACK_TRIGGERED: 3 consecutive failures triggered rollback. FAIL_INTERMITTENT: failures occurred but did not reach rollback threshold (for RETURNED_FOR_MONITORING).
